children: Life sciences Iambic Therapeutics filed for an initial public offering in the US on Monday.
The San Diego, California-based company plans to sell new shares in the offering.
Founded in 2019 as Entos, Iambic is developing a pipeline of medicines to treat diseases such as breast cancer.
J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, BofA Securities and Citigroup are the underwriters for the offering.
Iambic will list on the Nasdaq under the symbol "IAM".
